hosts.cause: The README documents the short -v option. The workflow used unsupported --version, which Taskell interpreted as a board filename and prompted for creation; the noninteractive process then exited at EOF.

The workflow queried standalone ghc on PATH although Stack had been configured with no global compiler. It exited before running stack test; the lane is being changed to rely on the resolver-managed compiler.

disposition: Preserve the 250 passing Linux upstream tests and the two distinct workflow/tool invocation errors. The target binary was built on Linux but not retained by this failed job. The corrected lane uses the documented -v option and records the resolver-managed compiler.
